title: The Cave-In
text: The roof comes down behind you with a roar, and then silence, and dust so thick you cannot see your hands. When it clears, the way back is gone, sealed with a wall of broken stone. Somewhere in the dark ahead, something has heard.

options.label: Everyone digs, in the dark, and nobody speaks of what is listening.

outcomes.text: Hours of it, hands bleeding, in the silence, with something listening ahead and never coming closer.

options.label: The strongest clears the rubble, stone by stubborn stone.

outcomes.text: Faster, and the stone fights them every inch, as if it wants you to stay.

options.label: Go forward. There is no going back now, so meet whatever heard you.

outcomes.text: Deeper, into the dark, where the thing that heard is waiting.
